proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Provided all valid code candidates sequentially based on clues
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Repeated failure to identify the single intended answer among multiple candidates
proposed_memory.lesson: When multiple valid candidates exist, prioritize selecting the single intended answer rather than listing all possibilities or switching among them
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Analyze clues more deeply or apply additional logic to identify the unique intended code before submission
proposed_memory.observed_problem: Multiple valid candidates without clear uniqueness led to incorrect or invalid submissions
